bio_en: Hovhannes Flean, called Jeoch-Agha and Tachat, came from a very poor family of Van and after the Norashen parish school joined the Armenakan movement. In the 1896 Van fighting he defended position after position against troops and mob, then went to Persia and Russia. Returning to Van, he was invited onto the local committee after Vardges's arrest, though a sedentary post did not satisfy him; in 1903 he went abroad for the General Congress. In spring 1904, returning with an arms-carrying band, he was killed only two or three hours from Van, aged 25.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium.
